lines.text: Plan failed. Back to square one.

data.define: Used when your progress is lost and you must restart.

example.text: Plan failed. Back to square one.

misuse.text: Don't say 'back to square one' after small progress.
misuse.why: It means you lost all progress.

data.l1_hook: O plano falhou. E agora, "back to square one"?

native.tip: “back to square one” = voltar à estaca zero. Exemplo: “Plan failed. Back to square one.”
native.caption:
O que significa “back…”?
“back to square one” = voltar à estaca zero.
Exemplo: “Plan failed. Back to square one.” (Plano falhou. "back to square one".)
